name: Enpass
description_en:
Enpass is a product in the Password management category. Its directory profile covers Password Reset, Password Generator, Secure Password Sharing, Multifactor Authentication, Offline Functionality, Backup/Restore, Third-party Integration, Password Encryption.

Additional listed capabilities include Saved Cards, Mobiles Password Management, Websites Password Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Not available.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $11.99. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create passwords using configured requirements. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
